name: FLOW Beat Link
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Sends each deck's beat, BPM, play state and track to FLOW VJ over the network, to lock visuals and lights.
description:
Rows: Send beat to FLOW (on), Send mixer to FLOW (on), Send track analysis to FLOW (on) and Send mixer data (test) (off).

Sends UDP packets on the deck's network (Wi-Fi or LINK), broadcast to port 9100 unless flow-beat:host in MODS/azmods.cfg names one computer: each new beat, BPM and beat position, track title and artist, each deck's own audio level, and the loaded track's rekordbox beat grid, waveform, phrases and hot/memory cues read off its USB, and the mixer's faders, crossfader, EQ, Color FX, Beat FX and X-PAD. FLOW VJ listens.

Reads files; never writes or patches the deck.
